summary: Wrote a five-phase, four-wave implementation plan relocating the --meta, --review and --dream sub-modes from memory's /distill surface into a new core-owned /telemetry command backed by a direct-execution skill-telemetry. Planning surfaced six dependencies the research inventory missed (the Shared Sub-Mode Skeleton, three .memory/ log and index paths, the missing Agent tool in allowed-tools, and the AskUserQuestion-withheld-from-subagents constraint) plus a record-versioning gate collision that rules out a verbatim copy; each is resolved by a named phase task. The unresolved invocation-surface question is decided in favor of /telemetry and relayed as a non-blocking user_decision.

artifacts.summary: Five-phase, four-wave relocation plan: author core content, register the new core surface, repoint cross-extension citations, retire the memory surface, redeploy and verify live.

user_decision.question: The three relocated sub-modes need a core-owned host command, since memory's /distill command file stays in the extension being retired. The plan picks the command's name; the sub-mode flag names and specifications are unchanged either way.
options: /telemetry --meta|--review|--dream -- one new core command hosting all three flags under their existing names
A different command name of your choosing (e.g. /signal or /reflect) hosting the same three flags
Fold --meta onto the existing /meta command and host only --review/--dream elsewhere
user_decision.recommended: /telemetry --meta|--review|--dream -- one new core command hosting all three flags under their existing names
